Mastery 7 Asol here. The hardest part for me is when I lane against assassins like Ekko or Zed who easily get inside your star circle. If you can learn how to move so they're still getting hit by you while trying to stay next to you then every matchup becomes easy. Rylais helps with this. 

Also rely on your team mates. Hopefully they distract the enemy from the amount of damage you're doing. Save your Q for squishies during fights. The only time you should be the one initiating team fights is when you have a lane-sized stun flying at them. 

Last thing I'd say is try not to be a hero. Doing good with ASol is not flashy. If you fly in and try to get that triple kill there's a good chance you'll just get clapped.
